text.offer: So you are a warrior? Ha! Don't look like much of a warrior to me. Before I will spend my time teaching you the valuable ways of the scimitar, you must prove yourself by slaying a cave orc. Do this and return to me.
text.complete: Finally. The first thing I must teach you is to snap to it. Come to me and we shall begin to learn how to effectively use the greatest weapon in the land: the scimitar.

steps.brief: That took long enough. I do not like to be kept waiting so long. With this extra time I have decided that you must slay yetis now: two of them. This time do not waste so many strokes with that...weapon. Go now.
